Services · 5

Everything we build, in one place.

Each service solves one problem facility teams deal with every week. They work on their own, and they work better together.

3D SCENE
01 · Computer vision

CCTV that catches ACs running in empty rooms.

EnergyCam turns the cameras you already have into an energy watchdog. It counts people, checks every AC in view, and alerts your team the moment cooling runs in an empty room.

  • Alert 10 seconds after a room empties
  • No new sensors or hardware
  • Waste shown in rupees, live
Explore computer vision Ask on WhatsApp
3D SCENE
02 · Digital twins

Your building in 3D, from its PDF drawings.

We turn the floor plans you already have into a live 3D model. Anyone on your team can find a room, trace an exit route or plan the roof, from a link.

  • Search any room in seconds
  • Exit routes on every floor
  • Opens in any browser
Explore digital twins Ask on WhatsApp

03 · AI agents

AI that checks every quotation, line by line.

An AI agent reads each vendor quotation, compares every rate with your past orders and flags anything unusual. A person still approves every spend.

  • Every line compared with past rates
  • Plain-English reason for each flag
  • A person approves every spend
Explore AI agents Ask on WhatsApp
3D SCENE
04 · Facility portals

Scan the tag. The job is logged.

Every asset gets a QR tag. Technicians scan it to open a work order, attach a photo and get reminders for the next service, on their own phones.

  • A QR tag on every asset
  • Photo proof on every job
  • Reminders before a service is due

05 · Energy + solar

Tune the HVAC. Put the sun to work.

We audit your HVAC and BMS to find where energy is lost, then design rooftop solar sized to your real daytime load.

  • HVAC and BMS audit on site
  • Fixes ranked by saving
  • Solar sized to your real load
